title: Who’s News: Strategic Appointments at SemiQon, OrangeQS, IonQ, Haiqu, and Jij - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Quantum Computing Report's personnel roundup: SemiQon and OrangeQS both hired Chief Commercial Officers (Thierry Botter, ex-QuIC; Raj Badoni, ex-KLA/ASM), IonQ replaced its CFO and CAO with Gary Merrill (ex-Commvault) and Thomas Austin (ex-Juniper), Haiqu hired ex-Quantinuum Kortny Rolston-Duce for ecosystem/marketing, and Jij named Oren Bernstein VP of North American business development. The common thread is commercialization-focused hires across quantum hardware, test infrastructure and software.

themes.theme: Quantum hardware supply chain CCO hires

insights.claim: SemiQon appointed Dr. Thierry Botter, former five-year Executive Director of the European Quantum Industry Consortium (QuIC), as Chief Commercial Officer to lead global commercialization of its cryogenically optimized CMOS hardware.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A well-networked European industry-association leader joining a cryo-CMOS startup signals a push from R&D toward commercial sales of quantum control/qubit hardware.
insights.locator: SemiQon has appointed Dr. Thierry Botter

insights.claim: Thierry Botter stepped down from QuIC in August 2026 after growing the European quantum industry association to over 230 members; he previously held advanced technology and innovation leadership roles at Airbus.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: QuIC leadership turnover and its 230+ member base indicate the scale of the European quantum ecosystem SemiQon can now tap.
insights.locator: Botter most recently served a five-year term

insights.claim: OrangeQS appointed semiconductor veteran Raj Badoni (formerly at KLA, ASM, Onto Innovation and SMART Photonics) as Chief Commercial Officer to scale its automated quantum chip testing infrastructure, including the OrangeQS MAX Partnership Program.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Hiring from semiconductor metrology/inspection incumbents suggests quantum chip test is being positioned as a semicap-style tooling market.
insights.locator: OrangeQS has appointed semiconductor industry veteran

insights.claim: IonQ (NYSE: IONQ) named Gary Merrill as CFO effective early December and Thomas A. Austin as Chief Accounting Officer effective immediately, with Austin succeeding Inder M. Singh.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Simultaneous CFO and CAO change at a listed quantum company is a governance event worth watching around upcoming filings and guidance.

insights.claim: IonQ's incoming CFO Gary Merrill was both CFO and Chief Commercial Officer at Commvault Systems, where he drove SaaS expansion and financial transformation.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: A SaaS-oriented finance chief may push IonQ toward recurring-revenue framing of its quantum business.

insights.claim: IonQ's new Chief Accounting Officer Thomas A. Austin has over three decades of accounting and regulatory compliance experience, including CAO at Juniper Networks and VP of Corporate Finance at EMC Corporation and Dell Technologies.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Large-cap compliance pedigree points to IonQ bolstering reporting controls as it scales.

insights.claim: Haiqu hired Kortny Rolston-Duce, formerly Director of Ecosystem Development at Quantinuum and earlier in marketing/communications at Atom Computing and Idaho National Laboratory, as Head of Ecosystem Development and Marketing.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Talent flowing from hardware leaders like Quantinuum to software startups indicates software layers are building developer ecosystems.

insights.claim: Haiqu is expanding researcher engagement across academia, government labs and commercial enterprises for its HaiquOS and AgenticOS software platforms.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Haiqu's agentic-branded OS product hints at quantum software vendors bundling AI-agent positioning.
insights.locator: At Haiqu, she will lead brand strategy

insights.claim: Japanese optimization and quantum software company Jij appointed Oren Bernstein as VP of Business Development for North America to lead its U.S. commercial expansion and strategic partnerships.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Japanese quantum/optimization software vendors are actively entering the U.S. market.
